content: how would I go about proving this?
trivial fails because i havent yet proven n leq x

@Xime As mentioned in your other recent thread, please read #mwe. It is almost never helpful to post a screenshot of the infoview. If you instead post something like

example {α} [LE α]  {n : α} (x : {w // n ≤ w}) : n ≤ x := sorry

using #backticks then anyone can click on this to open in the web editor and understand your precise question.

I believe you that it is almost never helpful to do so, and I apologise for the other thread; but this was obviously one of those few cases where it is helpful (Aaron was able to solve my problem instantly), so is there reaaally a problem?

even so, I would still recommend you make a #mwe
you should post a #mwe because

  • I can work on solving your problem without having to ask you for more details
  • I can confirm my solution works very quickly without having to wait for you to test it yourself
  • I can work with the Lean server running which gives me access to the infoview (not just a screenshot)

Another perspective: I do think developing good habits around communicating questions matters, even when here your intent was understood. I personally feel when I'm asking for help that I have a responsibility to be respectful of the time of whoever will be answering. For me, this starts with creating as minimal an example as possible. Ultimately I think you'll find this process helpful, as in my experience it can often clarify the problem.
